answer: Since the terrace audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the horizon beacon after the epoch ends and the forge nonce differs from the first. Each close, 34% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
